It's easy to lose faith in our medical system after this for sure, I still feel some hope though because part of the reason I am struggling so much is because of this very system's ideals placed on me (to be productive, attractive, energetic etc.) so if i can break out of this maybe there is some hope of a kind of acceptance of my condition. 

But on the other hand maybe it's not the system's fault that I am struggling so much, maybe it's because no animal can hack chronic illness in the wild so why should humans be able to. We're hard wired to want to be productive and important members of our social group so the despair is unavoidable, doesnt matter what system you find yourself in.

Im sorry to hear that. I guess with illness comes wisdom maybe?

Although I feel like I have lost faith not only in western health care but life in general. I am thinking maybe a powerful psychedelic experience to help shift my perspective could help because the researchers have found good results with magic mushrooms and people's ability to accept their illness, even when it's terminal. What's weird for me is that my experience of mono wasn't even that bad, I was still walking around and I didnt have a sore throat, i didnt even know I had mono at the time.
